description: Set Character and Paragraph panel options on type layers: anti-aliasing, text and warp orientation (vertical type), kerning, language, No Break, OpenType ligatures and oldstyle figures, the paragraph type box size, indents, paragraph spacing, hyphenation, justification spacing, hanging punctuation and the composer

boxHeight.description: Paragraph type: bounding box height in pixels

boxWidth.description: Paragraph type: bounding box width in pixels

composer.description: Adobe Every-line or Single-line Composer (Paragraph panel menu)

firstLineIndent.description: Indent first line in pixels (Paragraph panel)

limit.description: Most consecutive hyphenated lines; 0 for no limit

wordsLongerThan.description: Only hyphenate words with at least this many letters

zone.description: Hyphenation zone in pixels (Single-line Composer only)

autoLeading.description: Auto leading, percent of the type size

glyphScaling.description: Glyph scaling: percentages from 50 to 200, minimum <= desired <= maximum

letterSpacing.description: Letter spacing: percentages from -100 to 500, minimum <= desired <= maximum

wordSpacing.description: Word spacing: percentages from 0 to 1000, minimum <= desired <= maximum

kerning.description: Kerning (Character panel): metrics, optical or manual

language.description: Language for hyphenation and spelling (Character panel)

leftIndent.description: Indent left margin in pixels (Paragraph panel)

noBreak.description: No Break: keep words from breaking at line ends (Character panel menu)

orientation.description: Text orientation (Type > Orientation): vertical gives vertical type

rightIndent.description: Indent right margin in pixels (Paragraph panel)

spaceAfter.description: Add space after paragraph, pixels (Paragraph panel)

spaceBefore.description: Add space before paragraph, pixels (Paragraph panel)

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

warpOrientation.description: Orientation of the warp (Warp Text dialog)

name: set_type_options
title: Set Type Options
